actions.action: Move plant to bright indirect light, out of direct afternoon sun (sheer curtain)
Check top 2–3 cm of soil and water at soil level when dry
Make sure the pot drains and empty any standing water
Optionally trim the damaged leaf later if it bothers you or yellows
Gently straighten the bent petiole if it moves without force
Watch for new spots, yellow rims, mushy stems or drooping
If infection signs appear, remove affected leaves and let soil dry more

reason: The answer correctly calls the plant healthy with a cosmetically damaged leaf but makes mechanical damage the main cause and sun scorch secondary, and it mentions trimming only as an optional later step alongside sun protection, with nothing harmful.
